experiment: S6 no campaign, five fixed manifestos

design.rules: default GameConfig (zealots 5%, social step 0.15, β=20, z=0.825)
design.dynamics: social-only DeGroot steps, zealots frozen (= engine round with no spend)
design.metric: expected vote share E = mean_i σ(β(S_i − z)), in %; mean over worlds, t-based 95% CI

manifestos.archetype_vector_used: archetype TEMPLATE means (sectors.ARCHETYPES), not the regions' realised mean v(0)
manifestos.1 region: template of the largest region (integer percents)
manifestos.2 regions: x_playbook.ui_blend over the 2 largest regions (voter-weighted mean of templates → integer %)
